description: This file is a C header (.h) source file defining API interfaces related to TR-069 device IP diagnostics, specifically for trace route hops information. It contains function declarations for retrieving trace route hop details, such as host name/IP, error codes, and round trip times, used within the broader device management system.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_Host
methods.description: Retrieves the host name or IP address for a specific hop in the trace route.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_HostAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address or hostname returned for a specific trace route hop.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_ErrorCode
methods.description: Retrieves the ICMP error code associated with a specific trace route hop.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_RTTimes
methods.description: Retrieves the list of round trip times for a specific trace route hop.
